INTERACTIVE_MESSAGE.TITLE: Interactive message
INTERACTIVE_MESSAGE.SUBTITLE: Send tappable buttons or a list. Up to 3 options become buttons; more become a list.
INTERACTIVE_MESSAGE.BODY_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. How can we help you today?
INTERACTIVE_MESSAGE.HELP: The customer taps an option and the choice comes back into the conversation. Requires a WhatsApp (WAHA) inbox.
